name: B10-0232/2026 (S&D) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress," adopted in March 2026. The Parliament says this law could harm the languages, cultures and religions of ethnic minorities such as Tibetans, Uyghurs and Mongols. It asks China to repeal or heavily amend the law, and asks the European Union and its member states to raise these concerns with China.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Ethnic minorities in China, and diaspora communities in the EU.
- **What happens next:** The EU's diplomatic service and member states are asked to raise the issues in the next EU-China Human Rights Dialogue.
